text:
nina: pushed a docs PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 — clarifies pricing slabs, meter event naming, and adds a dashboard panel for billing anomalies. Need quick review before tomorrow AM.

kevin: skimmed. small question: you used 'slab' in a few places (pricing slab). Is that internal terminology? might confuse customers; prefer 'tier' or 'bracket'.

nina: product reviewed and said 'slab' is acceptable in technical billing docs, but I'll add a parenthetical 'aka tier/bracket' to reduce confusion.

ara: noted a broken link in the metering section — the sample webhook payload link 404s. Also the Grafana JSON hardcodes `region: eu-central1` which makes the preview look weird for others.

nina: good catch — replaced link target and swapped hardcoded region for `$env_region` in the dashboard vars.

kevin: CI flagged missing lang on two fenced blocks and a lint nit about passive voice in the 'how metering works' paragraph.

nina: fixed code fences and reworded that paragraph to active voice. pushed. @deploy-bot could you re-run doc CI?

deploy-bot: CI queued: linkcheck, docs-lint, grafana-validate.

docs-bot: docs-lint failed: example header names in SDK snippet don't match infra rename. See logs — SDK v4 expects `rate-limit-*` headers; legacy `x-rate-limit-*` still seen in example.

toshi: add a short migration table showing old -> new header names and a code example reading both for backwards compatibility. That's been a recurring support question.

ara: also change dashboard panel subtitle to "Billing anomalies (USD/min)" so units are explicit. and the panel aggregation note should state whether it's per-key or per-route.

nina: added migration table and compatibility snippet:```js
// support both header styles for older SDKs
const rem = res.headers.get('rate-limit-remaining') || res.headers.get('x-rate-limit-remaining');
const reset = res.headers.get('rate-limit-reset') || res.headers.get('x-rate-limit-reset');
```

kevin: looks good. approved once grafana-validate passes. :+1:

deploy-bot: grafana-validate passed. linkcheck passed. docs-lint passed.

docs-bot: CI success.

nina: merged PR and added a short note in release highlights. closing thread. :tada:
